scope: Public official-source research only; no account, address, receipt image, token or checkout session retained.

receiptReport.source: User receipt description relayed by task owner; image not independently inspected by this researcher

officialSources.title: Jush regulations index
officialSources.finding: No matching 75 PLN receipt offer or z5913 terms were located among the listed promotions. The first-order 70 PLN offer appears under ended promotions.
officialSources.doesNotProve: This does not prove the receipt code is invalid or that no separate offer exists.

officialSources.title: First-order 70 PLN Delio promotion
officialSources.finding: Different expired offer: 70 PLN against a 150 PLN minimum, from 19 November 2025 to 31 March 2026. It requires an active account without completed orders in Delio or other app services; the participant can benefit once. Excluded goods and packaging do not count toward its minimum. This offer cannot establish this receipt's 75 PLN amount, dates or product exclusions.

officialSources.title: Platform sales regulations effective 19 June 2026
officialSources.finding: The platform includes Jush and the Delio website. Normal registration verifies a phone and customer details; delivery details are needed for orders. Customers must provide truthful, current details. These general rules do not establish z5913 eligibility.

unknowns: Expiry time and authoritative time zone
Whether account creation must fall within a campaign period
researchLimits.expiryPolicy: No November expiry instant is fabricated. A Warsaw deadline requires matching dated evidence before enforcement.
researchLimits.accountPolicy: One account per person is the pilot policy. A new phone number does not establish a new eligible person. Legitimate new customers may complete normal registration; existing users sign in.
researchLimits.discountPolicy: Receipt eligibility is provisional. Only an observed verified current checkout quote bound to the same account/cart and exact code determines accepted discount. Cached estimates never subtract 75 PLN.
